description: Predict PCR products for a template and a pair of primers (IUPAC-aware, allows mismatches, handles circular templates). Primers may carry a non-templated 5' tail — a restriction site, a Gibson arm, a Kozak, a tag: a primer primes on its 3' end, and the tail is carried into the product rather than required to match. start/end are the TEMPLATE-derived span, `length` is the whole product including tails, and `features` marks which product bases came from the oligos (present only when there is a tail). Each end reports annealedLength and tailLength. When two primers make NO product on a template up to 60,000 bp, `diagnosis` says why: where each primer does prime (with the mismatched bases), which copying mistake explains one that primes nowhere (reversed but not complemented, complemented but not reversed, a base dropped or doubled, a mismatched 3' base) with the sequence that would bind, whether the two point the same way or away from each other, and the product a linear reading missed across the origin of a circle.

maxProductLength.description: Ignore predicted products longer than this (bp). A SEARCH WINDOW, not a claim about what amplifies: whole-plasmid inverse PCR — the reaction a q5-style site_directed_mutagenesis design is run as — makes one product the size of the plasmid, so raise this for a construct over 50 kb. `suppressedByLength` in the response counts what the window discarded.

reversePrimer.description: Primer 2, 5'→3' (order does not matter). Optional: one primer alone is accepted and reports the products it makes on its own — none, unless the template carries inverted sites it can prime from both ends.

template.description: Nucleotide sequence (raw or FASTA; IUPAC accepted).
